ex.s: Today, most records of biodiversity are often in the form of photos, videos, and other digital records.
ex.t: 如今，大多数生物多样性记录往往以照片、视频和其他数字记录的形式存在。

ex.s: I tend to travel with a few of my friends to state parks or to the countryside to go on adventures and take photos along the way.
ex.t: 我往往和几个朋友一起去州立公园或乡村探险，沿途拍照。

ex.s: I often leave early to seek the right destinations so I can set up early to avoid missing the moment I am attempting to photograph.
ex.t: 我经常早早出发去寻找合适的目的地，这样我可以提前架好设备，避免错过我想拍摄的瞬间。

ex.s: After we found a crazy-looking road that hung over a bunch of rocks, we decided to photograph the scene at sunset.
ex.t: 在我们发现一条悬在一堆岩石上方、造型奇特的公路后，我们决定在日落时分拍摄这个场景。

ex.s: Still, looking back on the photos, they are some of my best shots though they could have been so much better if I would have been prepared and managed my time wisely.
ex.t: 尽管如此，回头看这些照片，它们仍是我最好的作品之一，不过如果我准备充分、合理安排时间，它们本可以好得多。

ex.s: How does the author find his photos taken at Devil’s Lake?
ex.t: 作者觉得他在魔鬼湖拍的照片怎么样？

ex.s: The ____49____ (remark) development of this city, which is consciously designed to protect the past while stepping into the modern world, _____50_____ (mean) there is always something new to discover here, and I could be photographing Beijing for the next 50 years.
ex.t: 这座城市____49____（remark）非凡的发展——有意识地设计为在迈向现代世界的同时保护过去——_____50_____（mean）意味着这里总有新东西等待发现，我可以在未来50年里一直拍摄北京。

ex.s: Take some photos.
ex.t: 拍一些照片。

ex.s: Americans are still texting while driving, as well as using social networks and taking photos.
ex.t: 美国人仍在开车时发短信，同时使用社交网络和拍照。

ex.s: One fall，my wife Elli and I had a single goal:to photograph polar bears.
ex.t: 有一年秋天，我和妻子埃利只有一个目标：拍摄北极熊。

ex.s: Polar bears-like all wild animals-should be photographed from a safe distance.
ex.t: 北极熊——和所有野生动物一样——应该从安全距离外拍摄。

ex.s: About one month after this photo was took, I entered my second year of high school and become a new member of the school music club.
ex.t: 大约在这张照片拍了一个月后，我进入了高二，成为了校音乐俱乐部的新成员。

ex.s: I was looking at the photos on the noticeboard when I heard a voice behind me.
ex.t: 我正在看布告栏上的照片，这时听到身后传来一个声音。

ex.s: For example, in our free time we can sculpt a sculpture and paint a painting, but we take a photo.
ex.t: 例如，在空闲时间我们可以雕一座雕塑、画一幅画，但我们是拍一张照片。

ex.s: Recent additions include "selfie" (a photograph that you take of yourself, usually with a mobile phone) and "netizen" (a citizen who uses the Internet).
ex.t: 最近新增的词包括＂selfie＂（自拍照，通常用手机拍摄的自己照片）和＂netizen＂（网民，使用互联网的公民）。

ex.s: Dad showed me a photo we had taken then-just see how time flies!
ex.t: 爸爸给我看了一张我们那时拍的照片——看看时间过得真快！

ex.s: Sunday 20 October I was tidying my room yesterday and found an old photo in a notebook.
ex.t: 10月20日 星期日 昨天我在整理房间时，在一个笔记本里发现了一张老照片。
